page_title: SAS 1-0 INT | Sassuolo v Inter 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' A clumsy foul by Benjamin Pavard (Inter) and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle.
90+1' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo). Matteo Marchetti doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
89' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Benjamin Pavard (Inter), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
87' Nicolo Barella (Inter) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
86' Davide Ballardini prepares a substitution. Jeremy Toljan is replaced by Filippo Missori (Sassuolo).
86' Substitution. Matheus Henrique leaves the pitch and is replaced by Uros Racic (Sassuolo).
85' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Marko Arnautovic (Inter) heads on.
85' Tajon Buchanan (Inter) is adjudged offside.
82' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
82' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked. Now Inter have a corner.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
79' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
77' Two players stand over the free kick. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from distance is blocked by the defensive wall.
76' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) is caught offside!
74' Substitution. Davy Klaassen (Inter) replaces Kristjan Asllani.
71' Davide Ballardini has decided to substitute Luca Lipani and he is replaced by Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo).
69' Here is a change. Davide Frattesi is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Nicolo Barella (Inter).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tajon Buchanan (Inter) will replace Alessandro Bastoni.
69' Juan Cuadrado (Inter) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
66' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
65' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Henrikh Mkhitaryan walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
60' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Juan Cuadrado (Inter) replaces Denzel Dumfries.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kristian Thorstvedt trots off the pitch and is replaced by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo).
59' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
58' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
57' The referee blows his whistle as Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in his challenge.
53' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
50' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marchetti saw the whole situation.
48' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Inter players look gutted.
45+2' Wait! Referee Matteo Marchetti has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45+1' Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for an infringement.
43' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

42' Davide Frattesi (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.
40' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
39' Matteo Marchetti couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Josh Doig (Sassuolo) and blew his whistle.
38' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
36' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
34' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
32' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
29' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Andrea Consigli is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
28' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and makes a call.
26' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
25' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
24' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' 1 - 0 Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
19' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
16' Emil Audero makes a miraculous save! Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) gets to a rebound and attempts to put it into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives to stop his effort.
15' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

15' What a great touch by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' A cross from a corner kick by Sassuolo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
12' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
8' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle after Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
4' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) brings an opponent down and Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game.
4' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Sassuolo will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marchetti.
